## Data peserta pameran
- Expo: CIDEX 2024 · Tahun: 2024

- Produk dipamerkan: The Super Capacitor is a new energy storage device between the traditional capacitor and the secondary battery. It has both the high power characteristic of the traditional capacitor and the high energy characteristic of the battery, at the same time, super capacitor also has high specific power, high current charge and discharge capacity, long life, ultra-low temperature performance, high reliability, green and so on. High power density. The output power density is up to 10KW/kg, which can not be matched by any chemical power supply, and is tens of times of that of a common storage battery. The supercapacitor can provide high specific power with a specific energy of 5-10 Wh/ kg, a long cycle life of 1 million times, a wide working temperature range of -40 ° C ~ + 70 ° C, and a short charging time. Ultracapacitors can be charged in a few seconds at least, much faster than the battery charge time; long storage life. The electrode material used is also the most stable in the corresponding electrolyte, so the storage life of the supercapacitor can be considered almost unlimited; high reliability. The supercapacitor has no moving parts in the working process and is completely maintenance-free, so the reliability of the supercapacitor is very high.
